description: This file declares the 'DoorBell' class and its nested 'Connector' class, which manage doorbell signaling and resource binding in a networked environment. It includes method declarations for ringing, acknowledging, waiting, and unbinding the doorbell, as well as internal handling of socket communication.

classes.name: DoorBell
classes.description: Represents a doorbell mechanism with methods to ring, acknowledge, wait, and manage resource binding.

classes.name: DoorBell::Connector
classes.description: Handles network resource binding, socket communication, and detection of doorbell signals.

methods.name: DoorBell::Ring
methods.description: Triggers the doorbell signal and sets the internal event.

methods.name: DoorBell::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the doorbell event with a specified timeout.

methods.name: DoorBell::Ringing
methods.description: Sets the internal event indicating the doorbell has rung.
